from collections import deque
def comps(cells):
    cells=set(cells); seen=set(); sizes=[]
    for c in cells:
        if c in seen: continue
        q=deque([c]); seen.add(c); s=0
        while q:
            r,cc=q.popleft(); s+=1
            for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(r+dr,cc+dc)
                if n in cells and n not in seen: seen.add(n); q.append(n)
        sizes.append(s)
    return sizes
